MathResearch.Analysis.maurerCartan.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {E : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℝ A] [FiniteDimensional ℝ A] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {f g : E → Matrix ι ι A} {x : E} (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x)
  (hgf : (fun (y : E) => g y * f y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun (x : E) => 1) (hfg : f x * g x = 1) (v w : E) :
  (fderiv ℝ (fun (y : E) => g y * (fderiv ℝ f y) w) x) v - (fderiv ℝ (fun (y : E) => g y * (fderiv ℝ f y) v) x) w +
      (g x * (fderiv ℝ f x) v * (g x * (fderiv ℝ f x) w) - g x * (fderiv ℝ f x) w * (g x * (fderiv ℝ f x) v)) =
    0
MathResearch.Spinor.ballSection_maurerCartan (q v : ℍ) (hq : q ∈ Ball) :
  ballSectionInverse q * (fderiv ℝ ballSection q) v =
    (ballScale q)⁻¹ • !![2⁻¹ • (v * star q - q * star v), v; star v, connectionCoefficient q v]
MathResearch.Spinor.ballCurvature_eq (q v w : ℍ) (hq : q ∈ Ball) :
  ballCurvature q v w = -(ballScale q)⁻¹ ^ 2 • (star v * w - star w * v)
MathResearch.Spinor.projected_full_homogeneous (m : ℕ) (q : ℍ) (p : ↥(BinaryForm (m + 1))) (i : Fin 2) :
  ∑ μ : Fin 4,
      matrixColumn (quaternionMatrix (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ))
        (fun (j : Fin 2) =>
          (MvPolynomial.pderiv j)
            (infinitesimal (quaternionMatrix (star (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ) * q)) ↑p))
        i =
    (2 * (↑m + 2)) • matrixColumn (quaternionMatrix q) (fun (j : Fin 2) => (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ↑p) i
MathResearch.Spinor.projected_connection_homogeneous (m : ℕ) (q : ℍ) (p : ↥(BinaryForm (m + 1))) (i : Fin 2) :
  ∑ μ : Fin 4,
      matrixColumn (quaternionMatrix (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ))
        (fun (j : Fin 2) =>
          (MvPolynomial.pderiv j)
            (infinitesimal (quaternionMatrix (connectionCoefficient q (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ))) ↑p))
        i =
    (↑m + 3) • matrixColumn (quaternionMatrix q) (fun (j : Fin 2) => (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ↑p) i
MathResearch.Spinor.SC2_v1 (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (q : ℍ) (p : ↥(BinaryForm n)) :
  ((fun (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) =>
        ∑ μ : Fin 4,
          MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ *
            polynomialFueterCoefficients
              (infinitesimal (quaternionMatrix (star (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ) * q)) ↑p) d) =
      fun (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) => (2 * (↑n + 1)) • (q * polynomialFueterCoefficients (↑p) d)) ∧
    (fun (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) =>
        ∑ μ : Fin 4,
          MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ *
            polynomialFueterCoefficients
              (infinitesimal (quaternionMatrix (connectionCoefficient q (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ))) ↑p)
              d) =
      fun (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) => (↑n + 2) • (q * polynomialFueterCoefficients (↑p) d)

MathResearch.Spinor.SC1_v1 (m : ℕ) (F : QuaternionMatrix2 → ↥(BinaryForm (m + 1))) (hK : RightEquivariant (m + 1) F)
  (hF : ∀ (g : QuaternionMatrix2), IsSp11 g → DifferentiableAt ℝ F g) (q : ℍ) (hq : q ∈ Ball) :
  (∀ (v : ℍ),
      ballSectionInverse q * (fderiv ℝ ballSection q) v =
        (ballScale q)⁻¹ • !![2⁻¹ • (v * star q - q * star v), v; star v, connectionCoefficient q v]) ∧
    (∀ (v w : ℍ), ballCurvature q v w = -(ballScale q)⁻¹ ^ 2 • (star v * w - star w * v)) ∧
      ∀ (v : ℍ),
        rightLieDerivative (m + 1) F (ballSection q) v =
          ballScale q • (fderiv ℝ (fun x => F (ballSection x)) q) v +
            (infinitesimalAction m (quaternionMatrix (connectionCoefficient q v))) (F (ballSection q))
MathResearch.Spinor.SC3_v1 (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (f : ℍ → ↥(BinaryForm n)) (hf : ∀ q ∈ Ball, DifferentiableAt ℝ f q) :
  (∀ q ∈ Ball,
      ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        24 • schmidOperator n (fullLift n f) (ballSection q) d =
          ballWeight ((↑n + 4) / 2) q •
            MathResearch.Fueter.leftOperator (fun x => (fueterCoefficientCLM n d) (f x)) q) ∧
    ((∀ (g : QuaternionMatrix2), IsSp11 g → ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), schmidOperator n (fullLift n f) g d = 0) ↔
      ∀ q ∈ Ball,
        ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), MathResearch.Fueter.leftOperator (fun x => (fueterCoefficientCLM n d) (f x)) q = 0)
MathResearch.Spinor.SC3_representation_covariance_v1 (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (f : ℍ → ↥(BinaryForm n))
  (hf : ∀ q ∈ Ball, DifferentiableAt ℝ f q)
  (hkernel :

MathResearch.Spinor.SC3_smooth_correspondence_v1 (n : ℕ) :
  (∀ (f : ℍ → ↥(BinaryForm n)),
      (∀ q ∈ Ball, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f q) →
        RightEquivariant n (fullLift n f) ∧
          (∀ (g : QuaternionMatrix2), IsSp11 g → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fullLift n f) g) ∧
            ∀ q ∈ Ball, unweightedSpinor n (fun x => fullLift n f (ballSection x)) q = f q) ∧
    ∀ (F : QuaternionMatrix2 → ↥(BinaryForm n)),
      RightEquivariant n F →
        (∀ (g : QuaternionMatrix2), IsSp11 g → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F g) →
          (∀ q ∈ Ball, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (unweightedSpinor n fun x => F (ballSection x)) q) ∧
            ∀ (g : QuaternionMatrix2), IsSp11 g → fullLift n (unweightedSpinor n fun x => F (ballSection x)) g = F g

MathResearch.Spinor.rightLieDerivative_congr_on_group (n : ℕ) (F H : QuaternionMatrix2 → ↥(BinaryForm n))
